# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting **LingXi T3** (`LingXiFox/t3code` fork modifications, desktop identity/updater routing, or release/sync workflows) privately via [GitHub Security Advisories on LingXiFox/t3code](https://github.com/LingXiFox/t3code/security/advisories/new). Please do not disclose them publicly until there has been a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

For vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code or T3 Tools-operated infrastructure, report to [security@t3.codes](mailto:security@t3.codes) per the [upstream security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).
